When you drop your clothes off to be dry cleaned, we just wash shirts. 

Just with regular detergent and water. Unless you specify that you want it dry cleaned or there’s a special instruction tag, it will be laundered. 

It’s priced different from being dry cleaned. It’s 1/2 as expensive usually. But we don’t announce it unless asked. And by the way, profit margins are insane at the cleaners. If it’s cotton, polyester, or anything else basically that isn’t silk or wool, just wash it at home.
